propositions: Cloud's characterization suite pins hardcoded VALUES for priority map, status map, sanitizer boundaries, identity labels and field mapping branches but excludes Data Center backend entirely, asserting only by shape not value

Data Center backend has separate implementations (_DCOutbound, _DCInbound, _DCSanitizer, _map_local_to_dc_fields) that have never been value-pinned and are currently covered only by presence/shape assertions that pass with any wrong values
The shared OutboundFieldMapper.map_fields_to_remote is exercised through AdfCodec only, leaving WikiTextCodec path untested and creating a regression vulnerability for DC-specific composition defects

DC probe classification cannot be tested through the _backend() fixture seam because FakeTransport.probe_remote returns a static stub result, requiring instead direct calls to classify_probe_response or JiraDataCenterTransport over a real JIRA client
DC's DEFAULT_RESOLVED_STATUSES is byte-identical to Cloud's RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES, making any pin at defaults vacuous and unable to prove DC binds its own configuration rather than Cloud's

Create-path mapper must emit exact values for every key (summary, description, issuetype, priority, status, assignee) including defaults and fallbacks, sanitizer boundaries must be pinned at-limit and one-over, and probe branches must cover all four classification outcomes
